name: Mahaganapati Temple
description: The largest of the eight Ashtavinayak temples, where sunrays enter the inner sanctum on Surya-Sankranti. The idol has 10 trunks and 20 hands in its hidden form. Engineered to align with the sun at specific times of year.
hi_description: आठ अष्टविनायक मंदिरों में सबसे बड़ा, जहाँ सूर्य संक्रांति को अंदरूनी मंदिर में सूरज की किरणें सीधे देवता पर पड़ती हैं। मूर्ति का छिपा हुआ रूप 10 सूंड़ों और 20 हाथों वाला है।

name: Pataleshwar Caves
description: Ancient rock-cut caves in Pune (near Ranjangaon route), featuring a Shiva temple carved into the mountainside. Dating from around the 8th-9th century, the site shows intricate stone carvings and tunnel networks.
hi_description: पुराने समय में बना गुफा मंदिर, जहाँ शिव मंदिर पत्थर में उकेरा गया है। 8वीं-9वीं शताब्दी का माना जाता है।

name: Thibaw Palace
description: The palace where Burma's last king, King Thibaw, was exiled by the British in 1886. The building overlooks the Konkan coast and now operates as a museum documenting Burmese royal history and the exile period.
hi_description: वह महल जहाँ बर्मा के अंतिम राजा को 1886 में अंग्रेजों द्वारा निर्वासित किया गया था। अब संग्रहालय है।

name: Ratnadurg Fort
description: Historic coastal fort overlooking the Arabian Sea, built in the medieval period. Offers panoramic sea views and is accessible via a short walk from town. The fort structure shows typical Marathi military architecture.
hi_description: अरब सागर के किनारे बना ऐतिहासिक किला जो समुद्र के शानदार दृश्य दिखाता है।

name: Jaigad Fort with Lighthouse
description: Medieval fort located 30km from Ratnagiri, featuring a restored lighthouse that guides coastal navigation. The fort sits on a clifftop with views of the Konkan coast and smaller islands. Access is via steps carved into the hillside.
hi_description: रातनागिरी से 30 किमी दूर बना किला जहाँ एक नई रोशनी घर बनी है। समुद्र का सुंदर दृश्य दिखता है।

name: Kaas Plateau
description: UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site with 850+ flowering plant species. The laterite plateau blooms September-October in a carpet of wildflowers. Online entry permits required; daily visitor cap enforced. Designated walking paths must be followed.
hi_description: यूनेस्को की विश्व प्राकृतिक विरासत स्थल जहाँ सितंबर-अक्टूबर में 850 से अधिक फूल खिलते हैं।

name: Sajjangad
description: Hilltop temple dedicated to Ramdas Swami, a 17th-century saint. The fort-temple complex overlooks Satara town and involves a trek or ropeway access. Historic site of pilgrimage with panoramic city and valley views.
hi_description: राम दास स्वामी को समर्पित पहाड़ी पर बना मंदिर। सताड़ा शहर का शानदार दृश्य दिखता है।

name: Thoseghar Waterfalls
description: Two-stage waterfall near Satara, most impressive during monsoon (June-September) when water flow is heavy. The falls descend into a natural pool. Best viewed from the overlook point accessible via short walk.
hi_description: सताड़ा के पास दो स्तरों वाला जलप्रपात। मानसून में सबसे खूबसूरत दिखता है।

name: Samadhi Mandir
description: The primary temple in Shirdi complex housing Sai Baba's marble tomb. The sanctum contains the idol of Sai Baba in Italian marble. The temple receives 40,000+ daily visitors. Online darshan passes reduce queue times significantly.
hi_description: साई बाबा के मकबरे को समर्पित मुख्य मंदिर। इटली के संगमरमर से बनी मूर्ति रखी है।

name: Dwarkamai Mosque
description: The mosque where Sai Baba lived and spent his days. Located adjacent to Samadhi Mandir. The structure retains authentic period features and is revered by both Hindu and Muslim devotees as a sacred space.
hi_description: वह मस्जिद जहाँ साई बाबा रहते थे। समाधि मंदिर के बगल में स्थित है।

name: Chavadi
description: The building where Sai Baba alternately slept on different nights. Now a revered shrine with the original structure preserved. Devotees visit to pay respects at the space where Baba resided.
hi_description: वह इमारत जहाँ साई बाबा रात को सोते थे। अब पवित्र मंदिर बना दिया गया है।

name: Shani Shingnapur
description: Ancient Shani (Saturn) temple 65km from Shirdi, famous for a village with no locked doors (traditionally). The temple sits atop a black stone representing Shani. A popular day-trip addition to Shirdi visits.
hi_description: शनि मंदिर जो 65 किमी दूर स्थित है। काले पत्थर पर शनि देव की पूजा की जाती है।

name: Siddhivinayak Temple
description: One of eight Ashtavinayak temples, uniquely situated on a Bhima River island. Only Ashtavinayak with trunk turning right (considered harder to please). The only east-facing temple in the series. Reached via bridge from the riverbank.
hi_description: भीमा नदी के द्वीप पर बना अष्टविनायक मंदिर। यह एकमात्र मंदिर है जहाँ गणेश की सूंड दाईं ओर है।

name: Bhima River Island Crossing
description: The Bhima River crossing provides scenic views of the river valley. The bridge approach offers photography opportunities and natural landscape views. A peaceful spot for brief respite during temple visits.
hi_description: भीमा नदी के पार मंदिर तक पहुँचने का रास्ता। नदी का सुंदर दृश्य दिखता है।

name: Tadoba Lake
description: The lifeline of Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, where most wildlife congregates. Morning and evening safaris circle the lake for tiger, leopard, and wild dog sightings. The lake's shoreline is the most productive viewing area in the reserve.
hi_description: ताडोबा-अंधारी बाघ अभ्यारण्य की जीवन रेखा। शेर, तेंदुआ और जंगली कुत्ते यहाँ दिखते हैं।

name: Moharli Gate
description: The most popular and busiest entry gate to Tadoba Tiger Reserve. Safaris depart early morning (5:30am) and afternoon (2pm). Gate is within walking distance of major resorts. Online permit booking is essential during peak season.
hi_description: ताडोबा के सबसे लोकप्रिय द्वार से शेर की सफारी शुरू होती है।

name: Navegaon Gate
description: An alternative entry gate to Tadoba providing access to less-crowded safari routes. Suitable for visitors seeking solitude and a different wildlife viewing experience. Morning safaris offer excellent tiger and bird-watching opportunities.
hi_description: ताडोबा का एक अन्य द्वार जो कम भीड़ वाली सफारी प्रदान करता है।

name: Sindhudurg Fort
description: 17th-century fort built by Maratha king Shivaji, located on an island 300m offshore. Accessible by boat from Tarkarli beach. The fort has temple ruins, cannons, and panoramic sea views. Boat rides depart regularly.
hi_description: शिवाजी द्वारा बना किला जो समुद्र में टापू पर खड़ा है। नाव से जाया जा सकता है।

name: Tarkarli Beach
description: Long, clean stretch of sand with clear water ideal for swimming, snorkelling, and scuba diving. Water clarity reaches 20 feet, among India's best. Uncrowded compared to other Konkan beaches. Perfect for water sports and sunset viewing.
hi_description: तारकरली के समुद्र तट की साफ रेत और स्वच्छ पानी। स्कूबा डाइविंग के लिए सबसे अच्छी जगह।

name: Devbaag Confluence
description: Where the Karli River meets the Arabian Sea. Beautiful spot for kayaking, sunrise viewing, and photography. The confluence creates a unique landscape where river and ocean waters meet. Quiet and peaceful environment.
hi_description: जहाँ करली नदी अरब सागर से मिलती है। कयाकिंग के लिए अच्छी जगह।
